breakdown.description: Lumped-capacitance method is requested even though Bi=5 violates the small-Biot validity condition.
breakdown.reason: The Agent kept Bi = 5 and proceeded to apply the lumped-capacitance method without any correction or warning. The ground truth requires either reducing Bi to 0.05 for the lumped-capacitance method to be valid, or switching to a spatially resolved transient conduction model for Bi = 5. The Agent did neither — it simply repeated the original flawed instruction.
